title: BLENDED-WING TAILSITTER
subtitle: Takes Off Like a Rocket, Flies Like a Plane
bom: Pixhawk 6C Mini Flight Controller (PX4 + Tailsitter Patch)
2x 40A ESCs + 6V Servo BEC + 4S1P Molicel P50B 21700 Pack
2x Metal-Gear Elevon Servos + Bay Latch Servo
M10 GPS, Airspeed Sensor + Pitot, ELRS
LW-PLA Vase Skins, PETG Structure + Feet, Carbon Spars
description: A 3D-printed blended-wing delivery drone with two props and nothing that tilts. It stands on its tail, climbs like a rocket, pitches over and flies as a flying wing, then zooms back up into a hover to drop a 250 g parcel from a bay on its centre of gravity. Generated in Python, checked by a 23-point gate and a premortem, and flown through a full delivery in PX4 + Gazebo simulation, with a custom Gazebo plugin for its aerodynamics and a small PX4 patch for its back transition. Sliced for a Kobra X and a Kobra S1: printing next.

title: TILT-ROTOR VTOL PLANE
subtitle: 3D-Printed Tricopter VTOL, Designed in Python
bom: M10 GPS, Airspeed Sensor + Pitot, ELRS
LW-PLA Vase Skins, PETG Structure, Carbon Spars
description: A 3D-printed tilt-rotor tricopter that takes off like a drone and flies like a plane. Every part is generated in Python from one parameter file, sliced from the command line and checked by a 123-check verification gate. PX4 flies the whole mission in Gazebo simulation, transitions included, on a model generated from the same design.

title: STM32 RETURN-TO-HOME DRONE
subtitle: Custom PCB Flight Controller on F450 Frame
bom: STM32F103C8T6 (Blue Pill) on a Custom KiCad Board
GPS Module for Return to Home
description: A quadcopter flying on a flight controller built from scratch: an STM32 Blue Pill on a KiCad-designed board that sits on top of an F450 frame, running Joop Brokking's YMFC-32 firmware with GPS return to home. CAD model, schematic, board layout, assembly and flight test, with every file published on GrabCAD. A two-person build with 10,000+ views on Hackster.

title: COVID-19 TESTING DRONE
subtitle: NXP HoverGames Challenge 2 · Bonus Prize
bom: NXP NavQ Companion Computer (i.MX 8M Mini) + Camera
Ultrasonic Sensor for a Safe Landing
SIM800L GSM Module for Position Updates
Sample Box for a Swab Kit
description: A drone you order from a phone app to collect a COVID-19 test sample, so a sick person never has to leave quarantine. The app sends the location, the drone flies out with a swab kit, picks a safe spot to land with its camera and ultrasonic sensor, and returns once the sample is in its box. The Android app and Firebase backend were built and the drone flew on NXP's HoverGames kit; autonomous flight to the requested location was the next step. Won a bonus prize in NXP HoverGames Challenge 2.

title: PX4 VISION FOLLOW-ME
subtitle: Target Tracking With YOLO and ROS 2, in Simulation
bom: PX4 Autopilot (SITL) on a Quadcopter Model
description: A drone that finds a target and follows it on its own. A YOLO detector locates the target in the camera and depth images, a ROS 2 node turns its position into offboard setpoints for PX4, and the video streams to QGroundControl. Developed and tested end to end in Gazebo against PX4 SITL, with a deployment guide for a Raspberry Pi companion computer.

title: CHEMICAL HAZARD TESTING RANGER
subtitle: NXP HoverGames 3 · Team Entry
bom: NXP HoverGames Rover Kit: the Sampling Rover
description: A drone that delivers a small rover to a chemical facility. It lands, the rover drives inside to sample the air with a Bosch BME688 gas sensor while operators watch its video, and the drone flies it back to base. Requested from a phone app built with Flutter, Firebase and Google Maps. A three-person NXP HoverGames 3 entry, taken through design and Gazebo simulation.

title: S500 QUADCOPTER BUILD
subtitle: Kit Quadcopter: Assembled, Debugged and Flown
description: An S500 quadcopter built from the kit: assembled, its wiring debugged on the bench until everything checked out, then flown outdoors.

title: SHARK 1:8 SCALE RC PLANE
subtitle: 3D-Printed From Shark.Aero's Published Design
bom: Brushless Motor, ESC and LiPo Battery
description: A 1:8 scale model of the Shark two-seat light aircraft, printed from the free design that Shark.Aero, the full-size aircraft's maker, publishes, then assembled with its motor, servos and RC gear. The video covers the print and the assembly; it has not been flown yet.

title: COLLIDE-O-SCOPE
subtitle: Guardrail Collision Alerts · Senior Design IoT System
bom: Kinetic Impact Sensor on the Guardrail
description: WRECKS, a Wireless Roadside Emergency Collision Kinetic Sensor, and not a drone: a node on the guardrail detects an impact and sends a real-time alert over LoRa and cellular to a phone app and a web dashboard. Mississippi State senior design, 2022: a five-person team led by Ajaya, with Atwood Fence Company as industry advisor, field-tested at their site.
